formulas.tex: \term{x}{X} = \sum_{(i,j) \in \term{pairs}{S}} \mathbf{1}\big[\,\lvert t_i - t_j \rvert \le \term{threshold}{\tau}\,\big], \qquad \term{p}{p} = \frac{1 + \term{greater}{\#\{s : X_s \ge X\}}}{\term{permutations}{P} + 1}, \qquad \term{expected}{E[X]} = \frac{\lvert S \rvert\, T}{n(n-1)/2}
formulas.ascii: X = number of listed spatial pairs (i < j) with |t_i - t_j| <= tau. p = (1 + #{permutations s with X_s >= X}) / (P + 1): one-sided (excess of close pairs), the +1 counts the observed value, ties count as exceedances. E[X] = |S| T / (n (n - 1) / 2) with T the number of time-close pairs among all n (n - 1) / 2 pairs. Times are permuted over fixed locations (swap-or-not shuffle, fixed seed).
